name: Hollow Knight
description: Adds Hollow Knight-style mechanics: Soul system, nail attacks, Monarch Wings (double jump), Mantis Claw (wall cling & wall jump), Mothwing Cloak (dash), Crystal Heart (super dash), and Focus healing.
author: Parkoreen

pogoBouncePower.label: Pogo Bounce Strength
pogoBouncePower.description: Upward strength after a downward nail hit, relative to normal jump force.

monarchWingJumpPower.label: Monarch Wing Jump Strength
monarchWingJumpPower.description: Double-jump upward force as a fraction of the map's normal jump force.

mantisClaw.label: Mantis Claw (Wall Jump)
mantisClaw.description: Cling to walls and wall jump

nailSpeed.label: Nail Attack Speed
nailSpeed.description: Base: 0.41s between attacks. Quick Slash: 0.25s between attacks.

slashEffects.label: Nail Slash Effects
slashEffects.description: Draw the animated slash arc during attacks.

impactEffects.label: Impact and Landing Effects
impactEffects.description: Draw nail-hit sparks, damage flashes, landing dust, and Soul motes released by Soul Statues.

cameraShakeEffects.label: Camera Impact Effects
cameraShakeEffects.description: Add a short camera shake for nail hits, landings, and Super Dash wall impacts.

impactShakeIntensity.label: Hit Shake Strength
impactShakeIntensity.description: Maximum screen-pixel shake for nail hits and Super Dash wall impacts. Set to 0 to disable hit shake.

landingShakeIntensity.label: Landing Shake Strength
landingShakeIntensity.description: Maximum screen-pixel shake for landings. Set to 0 for softer landings.

dashTrailEffects.label: Dash Trails
dashTrailEffects.description: Draw afterimages while dashing and super dashing.

abilityAuraEffects.label: Charge and Focus Auras
abilityAuraEffects.description: Draw progress auras while charging Super Dash and healing.

nailEffectColor.label: Nail Effect Color
nailEffectColor.description: Hex color used by slash and nail impact effects.

dashEffectColor.label: Dash Trail Color
dashEffectColor.description: Hex color used by dash afterimages.

chargeEffectColor.label: Super Dash Charge Color
chargeEffectColor.description: Hex color used by the Super Dash charge aura.

healEffectColor.label: Focus Aura Color
healEffectColor.description: Hex color used by the Focus healing aura.
